response: ["Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness and for melanoma in situ (source PMID 30392755, table‑x).","Surgical margins for melanoma should be based on tumor thickness (source PMID 30392755, table‑x).","Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary melanoma tumor and in the same operative setting whenever possible (source PMID 30392755, table‑x).","When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1–3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis (source PMID 39709737, recommendation 1).","Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as lesions on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and on the genitalia (source PMID 39709737, recommendation 1).","The consensus rate for the recommendation is 100 % (21 out of 21).","Changing the assessment of ‘blue_whitish_veil’ from absent to present increased the 7‑point score from 4 to 6.","The increased score did not change the recommendation verdict, which remains excision, because both scores are ≥3."]
